issues.title: LO-8: RemoteConsole nextClientId wraps after 4B connections
issues.body:
Copied from https://github.com/JN0V/DomoticsCore/issues/163 for a trial of workline's line on this copy.

| LO-8 | RC | `nextClientId` wraps after 4B connections |

Opened from `docs/CODE-ROADMAP.md`, lines 6328 to 6328 by the product-owner role.

<!-- workline:import=docs/CODE-ROADMAP.md:0b78948db2b0 -->

## Need

A person running a console on a device that stays up for years needs each connected client to keep its own id, so one client is never mixed up with another after the id counter wraps.

## Verification

A native test on RemoteConsoleComponent that sets the counter near UINT32_MAX and connects clients, then checks that ids stay unique among live clients and that none is 0. It can use the existing clientStateEntriesForTest() hook.

## Validation

- **Wrap keeps ids distinct:** Given the client id counter is set just below its 32-bit maximum and a client is still connected, When more clients connect so the counter wraps, Then every connected client has a different id.
- **No zero id:** Given the counter is at its maximum, When the next client connects, Then its id is not 0.

## Scope

RemoteConsoleComponent client id counter: `nextClientId` (uint32_t) and its increment when a client is accepted in loop()

## Assumptions

- Assumption taken on 2026-11-04, the Need and Validation drafts unanswered after 5 min: written as the role drafted it, for a person to correct.
